facts.title: Healthy Zucchini Muffins
ingredients: ¾ cup roughly chopped raw walnuts or pecans (optional)
⅓ cup melted coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil*
½ cup honey or maple syrup
⅔ cup buttermilk (or ⅔ cup milk of choice mixed with 2 teaspoons vinegar, allow to rest for 5 minutes before using)
1 ¾ cups white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour
facts.author: Cookie and Kate
